description: Election Commission - Mr. Weerasinghe Arachchige Don Regee was elected as the member of the ward No. 08 Salamulla of Kolonnawa U. C.
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kolonnawa Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This content falls squarely within the definition of Elections Gazettes, which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members.
